name: Riajuu Saimin ~Real ga Juujitsu Suru Saimin Seikatsu Hajimemashita.~
original_name: リア充催眠～リアルが充実する催眠生活はじめました。～
source:
Hibiki is a typical otaku who lacks confidence in a typical city, annoyed (and jealous) at all the lovey-dovey couples at school and in town. One day, he discovered some materials left by his grandfather on hypnosis and studied it semi-interestedly. He tried it on himself first, instructing himself to become popular, to become the riajuu that he so despised. He fell asleep and the next day, he thought that the hypnosis didn’t work, but soon girls who weren’t interested in him at all before are all over him!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/03/01/march-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
青山響是生活在一座平凡城市裡的典型宅男，對自己毫無信心。無論學校還是街頭，到處都是恩恩愛愛的情侶，令他感到煩躁，也嫉妒不已。

某天，他發現了祖父留下的一些催眠資料，便懷著一半好奇、一半無所謂的心態研究起來。他首先拿自己做實驗，命令自己變得大受歡迎，成為他一向那麼厭惡的「現充」。
隨後，響陷入沉睡。第二天醒來時，他以為催眠根本沒有奏效。可沒過多久，那些過去對他絲毫不感興趣的女孩，竟全都主動纏了上來！

［引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/03/01/march-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
